description_en: Retrieves the cloud storage recording lifecycle of an IPC device
description_zh: 调用该接口，获取IPC设备在云端保存录像文件的时间，即录像生命周期
name: QueryDeviceRecordLifeCycle

parameters.help_en: The list of IoT IDs of the IPC devices. An IoT ID is a unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for a device. You can call the IoT Platform https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html operation to query the IoT ID
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的IotId列表。IotId是物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。

可调用物联网平台https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html查询
parameters.name: device_list

Code.description_en:
The return code.

200: The call is successful.
Other values: An error code. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：

200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）

Day.description_en: The recording lifecycle of the IPC device

IotId.description_en: The IoT ID of the device

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
